programs.title: The Green Planet
programs.desc: The creators of the production invite viewers on a journey through the lush world of plants.It hides many surprising phenomena and hundreds of amazing heroes.Thanks to the lenses of specialized cameras, the mysterious life of nature's creations will be shown up close.Scientific research shows that nature is a perfect system of connecting vessels.In each of the five episodes, we will learn about a different group of plants and the secrets of their survival.The creators will talk about, among others:stories about seeds that can survive civilizations, trees that take care of each other, and creatures of nature that are as aggressive and spontaneous as animals.We will also learn about the relationships between people and animals with plants.It turns out that plants count, hunt, cheat, communicate, protect their relatives and manipulate animals for their own purposes.Contrary to appearances, when plants and animals interact with each other, it is usually the plant that sets the tone of the relationship.The series' narrator will be Sir David Attenborough, a popularizer of natural science.

programs.title: Dynasties
programs.desc: Chimpanzees are an endangered species.These animals live in complex social structures.Pack leaders can control them through various conflict and cooperation strategies.The power in the group is exercised by the alpha male, who rules by winning fights with his competitors.David, the leader of a tribe of chimpanzees living in the forests of Senegal, retains his title for the third year in a row.His herd is struggling, among other things, with the effects of long-term drought and deforestation caused by the gold rush, and David is surrounded by rivals, younger chimpanzees who want to overthrow him.They are ready to kill for this purpose.To stay in power, the dominant animal uses political arrangements.

programs.title: World's Most Amazing Walks
programs.desc: Robson Green gained popularity, among others, thanks to the role of an experienced detective in the crime series "Grantchester".Privately, the actor is a great lover of hiking and fishing.The new series documents eight expeditions along selected tourist routes in Europe.The artist traveled, among others, the northern coast of Normandy, following in the footsteps of soldiers taking part in a key battle of World War II.On the Trail of the Eagles' Nests in Poland, he had the opportunity to admire impressive landscapes and the ruins of medieval castles.A monument to a bygone era. Robson Green begins exploring the most beautiful trekking routes in the world in his native Great Britain.Hadrian's Wall is one of the most important monuments of ancient Rome on the Islands.The trail, divided into stages, is 135 kilometers long.It has special meaning for the actor because he grew up in this area.He follows familiar paths through the rugged moors.He has loved this landscape since childhood.He is amazed not only by nature, but also by the heritage of the past.He gets to know, among other things, Vindolanda - a Roman camp built in the 1st century.Archaeologists still make discoveries here related to the times of the Roman Empire.
